title: Argatroban Monitoring Using Surrogates in Surgical ICU Patients
summary:
Patients in the intensive care unit have an increased risk of developing blood clots and therefore require medications to thin the blood. Usually, heparin is used for this purpose. However, some patients cannot tolerate heparin and instead receive the medication Argatroban. For patients receiving intensive care, it is especially important that Argatroban is dosed correctly, as both too much and too little of the medication can lead to complications such as bleeding or blood clots. Therefore, the dosage must be individually adjusted.
Currently, the dosage is guided by a specific blood value. Studies have shown that this value is not always reliable in intensive care patients and can sometimes result in doses that are too high or too low.
The aim of this study is to determine which blood value is most suitable for guiding Argatroban dosing in order to make treatment safer. To achieve this, a small blood sample will be taken in addition to routine blood tests at six time points during Argatroban therapy. These samples will be used to measure various blood clotting values and compare them with the actual concentration of the medication in the blood. In this way, the blood value that most reliably supports correct dosing can be identified.
conditions: Coagulation disorders in surgical intensive care patients

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Treatment in a surgical intensive care unit (ICU) or intermediate care unit (IMC) at Heidelberg University Hospital
- Clinically indicated anticoagulation with Argatroban (suspected or confirmed heparin-induced thrombocytopenia type II (HIT II))
- Written informed consent obtained from the patient; in cases of temporary incapacity to consent, consent provided by the legal representative with subsequent confirmation by the patient once decision-making capacity has been regained
Exclusion criteria:
- Age <18 years
- Refusal to participate by the patient or, in case of incapacity to consent, by the legal representative
- Pregnancy or breastfeeding
